incidents-bot: :rotating_light: PAGING: KV cache prefix-hash oscillation detected for production continuous-batching route /gen/chat. Error rate spike + token latency increase. Paging oncall (Jess).

Jess (oncall): saw the alert, I'm on it. linking traces + sample keys now.

Jess (oncall): quick summary: 5xxs up ~3x, median p95 token latency from 220ms -> 980ms, throughput falling due to repeated cache miss storms. Seems correlated with recent tokenizer v2 rollout (rolled at 2025-10-15 03:00 UTC).

Mia L.: thanks. can you paste an example of the cache key pattern so infra/eng-runtime can grep?

Jess (oncall): yes — sample keys from logs: `prefix:v1:tokhash:0x7f4a3b:seq-128` then after spike we see `prefix:v1:tokhash:0x1a9dff:seq-128` and a bunch of `prefix:tokhash::seq-...` (empty token hash). suspect tokenizer mapping produced empty tokenization for certain templates, causing key churn.

Luis C.: looks like the tokenizer change introduced a small codepath that returns empty for placeholder-only templates. That empties part of the hash which collapses KV partitions and causes hot rebalancing.

Mia L.: continuous-batching has a batching config bump to 64 in the region (hotline change) — if keys are oscillating we get huge batch coalescing and then eviction storms. recommend reducing batch_max_tokens to 32 until we stabilize.

Jess (oncall): attempting quick config revert for batching via the console. @deploy-bot can you confirm the live change?

deploy-bot: Starting runtime config change: route=/gen/chat batch_max_tokens:64 -> 32. Change id: cfg-2025-1767. Rolling update to 24 workers in us-west-2. ETA ~45s.

Jess (oncall): patched. monitoring. p95 latency dropping in initial probes.

Raj P.: I'll take a deeper look at tokenizer v2 rollout. if the token hash function returns empty string for templates with only special tokens, that explains the null segment in keys. We should hotfix tokenizer to default to a sentinel token rather than empty.

Amelia (CS): customer note: two mid-market customers reported slowdown in generative preview feature, tickets #CS-1123 and #CS-1124. No data exfil, just performance regressions. Both informed we have an ops incident and will provide updates.

Jess (oncall): initial customer impact: ~7% of requests for affected routes saw >1s tail. no long-term failures, mostly timeouts in client SDKs after 1s. tagging incident P1 due to regression density and visible customer reports.

Luis C.: prepping a patch: tokenizer v2 fix -> ensure non-empty hash segment. patch branch: github.com/redwood/inference/infra#fix/tokenizer-empty-hash. Will run unit + e2e on staging. ETA 50m for PR + canary.

Mia L.: ops mitigation checklist: 1) batch_max_tokens revert (done) 2) increase KV cache TTL on prefixes temporarily to reduce churn 3) deploy tokenizer patch to canary 4) prepare rollback if canary shows errors. I'm toggling TTL to 120s -> 600s for prefix buckets.

Jess (oncall): TTL change applied. monitoring shows cache hitrate rising from 38% -> 72% over 4m. error rate dropping.

Raj P.: starting canary deploy of tokenizer patch to 4 nodes in staging, then 4 canary production nodes. will watch for key formats and seq drift.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment started: deploy/tokenizer-fix -> prod-canary-4. Watch groups subscribed.

Amelia (CS): sending customers a short status update: "We're investigating performance regressions affecting previews; mitigation in progress, expect updates within 1 hour."

Jess (oncall): handoff to Raj for root cause and patch validation. I'll stay available for final rollback if needed. Paging cleared to paging-channel after handoff. :white_check_mark:

Raj P.: taking over as oncall lead. next steps: validate tokenizer patch across templates, run key-mismatch diffs, confirm no template drift in templating engine (some templating code was updated in same deploy window). Will coordinate with product for template tests.

Mia L.: adding postmortem checklist to backlog: collect sample keys before/after rollout, batch config timeline, TTL deltas, customer impact matrix, and propose a safety gate for tokenizer rollouts that verifies key-semantics.

Jess (oncall): last check: p95 latency back to ~240ms, error rate normalized. closing active page, moving thread to incident retro.

incidents-bot: Incident 1767890123 status: mitigated -> monitoring. Postmortem assigned to Raj P. and Mia L.

Amelia (CS): marking customer tickets as 'ops incident - monitored' and will follow up once postmortem is published.

Raj P.: will run a full canary -> gradual rollout after successful key-stability tests. ETA full rollback window closure EOD.

Jess (oncall): thanks team. tagging this thread for follow-up: #postmortems and #eng-runtime.
